summary: After switching game modes using F3+F4, you need to press F3 twice to toggle the debug screen
description:
## The Bug

For some very odd reason you need to click F3 twice now if you change gamemodes this way. Doesn't affect commands. Very good UI for the new gamemode screen I have to say, good work Mojang!

## Steps to Reproduce

 - Open the gamemode switcher and switch into any gamemode. (Hold F3 and press F4 to bring up this menu and to navigate between gamemodes).

 - Hit the F3 key in an attempt to enable the debug menu.

 - Take note of whether the F3 debug menu is enabled.

 - Hit the F3 key again.

 - Take note as to whether or not the F3 debug menu is now enabled.

## Observed Behavior

After using the gamemode switcher, you are required to press the F3 key twice in order to enable the debug menu.

## Expected Behavior

After using the gamemode switcher, you would not be required to press the F3 key twice in order to enable the debug menu. Instead, you should only have to press the F3 key once in order to enable the debug menu after using the gamemode switcher.

## Code analysis

Code analysis by TriWonder81 can be found in this comment.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft.
2. Select Singleplayer.
3. Create and enter a new Creative world with default settings.
4. Hold F3 and press F4 to open the gamemode switcher.
5. Use the gamemode switcher to select any gamemode.
6. Press F3 once.
7. Observe whether the F3 debug screen is enabled.
8. Press F3 again and observe that the F3 debug screen is now enabled.

Observed Behavior:
After switching to another game mode through the **F3+F4 game mode switcher**, the next press of **F3** does not toggle the debug screen as expected. The debug screen remains closed. Pressing **F3 a second time** then opens the debug screen normally.

This behavior occurs specifically after using the F3+F4 game mode switcher; changing game modes through commands does not reproduce the issue.
Expected Behavior: After switching game modes with the F3+F4 game mode switcher, pressing F3 once should immediately enable the debug screen. The first F3 press should not be ignored or require a second key press, and the debug screen should toggle normally after the game mode change, just as it does when no game mode switch has occurred.
